Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly commit freeze & pipeline scrub — prep + call agenda

Team,

Quick heads-up for this week’s forecast cadence. Finance needs a clean commit snapshot by EOD Wednesday (2027-06-23). To meet that we’re doing a short pipeline scrub + commit lock process tomorrow. Please do the following before the 9:30 AM scrub call: 

1) Update your deals in the shared sheet (link below) with the current close probability, expected close date, and any blockers. Mark any deals that should be treated as "commit-exception" with a short justification.
2) Run the attached pipeline-cleanup-template.xlsx against your top 15 BANT deals and capture anything that moves stages.
3) If you anticipate an escalation, loop in CS and your AM; note the request in the commit-exceptions-log.csv.

Call details:
- When: Mon, 2027-06-21 09:30–10:00 PT
- Where: Zoom (invite to follow)
- Agenda (30 min):
  • Quick hygiene triage (10 min) — deals moved or data fixes
  • Commit calls (10 min) — finalize what goes into Wednesday lock
  • Exceptions & credits (5 min) — who needs finance approval
  • Next steps & assignees (5 min)

Priority notes:
- HorizonTech (HT-ENT-2027-Q3-42): large enterprise close that Marcus is shepherding. Marcus — please add a brief recovery plan in the sheet; if anything is above $250k and at risk, mark as a credit/exception for finance review.
- Alicia from Acme (external) scheduled a last-minute PO confirmation. If it’s not verbatim by Tuesday, treat as not-committed.

Attachments: pipeline-cleanup-template.xlsx (worksheet), call-agenda-20270621.pdf
Links: https://docs.redwood.ai/spreadsheets/pipeline-cleanup-2027

Thanks — see you on the scrub call,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

All — a couple of clarifications before the scrub:
- Please set the Close Date to the month-level (e.g., 2027-07-31) when there's a date skid; avoid exact-day guesses. That helps finance modeling.
- If you need a pre-approved credit > $10k to keep a deal in commit, attach the preliminary credit justification in the exceptions sheet — we will escalate to finance by Tuesday COB.
- Marcus — can you confirm whether HorizonTech's procurement requires a PO or SOW first? If it's a Procurement PO, we treat the close differently in the commit model.

I updated the call-agenda-20270621.pdf with a 5-min addendum for credit thresholds.

— Lauren

Folks — thanks for the quick updates earlier today. Two quick follow-ups after the scrub: 

1) Marcus: saw your recovery plan in the sheet — noted. Please attach the procurement note (PO vs SOW) to the HubSpot deal before EOD Wednesday. If HorizonTech requires a SOW first, mark as "deferred" for finance lock.
2) Vivek: I accepted your exceptions; please make sure Alicia's PO confirmation email is copied into the exceptions log so finance has evidence.
3) Lauren: Uploaded the updated call-agenda-20270621.pdf and attached the commit-exceptions-log.csv.

Forwarding the final agenda and the cleaned template. We will lock the commit snapshot on Wednesday at 17:00 PT. Anything not in the sheet by lock is out of commit for this cycle.

Attachments: commit-exceptions-log.csv, pipeline-cleanup-template.xlsx (updated)

Meeting summary (from the call):
- Hygiene caught: 9 deals moved stage, 4 deals removed from commit after qualification checks
- Credit escalations: 2 reqs forwarded to Finance (one >$10k, one >$250k)
- Action owners assigned in the sheet; most follow-ups due by Wed COB

If anyone needs a quick 1:1 to walk the sheet, ping me and I’ll slot time.
